description: This Dart source file defines a Flutter screen widget, `RecipeDetailScreen`, which displays detailed information about a recipe, including image, ingredients, tags, and directions. It incorporates state management via providers for favorites and recipe data, and constructs a scrollable UI with app bar, images, and lists.

classes.name: RecipeDetailScreen
classes.description: A stateless widget that displays detailed information about a specific recipe, including image, tags, ingredients, and steps, with favorite toggling functionality.

classes.name: _RecipeMeta
classes.description: A stateless widget that shows metadata about the recipe such as duration, servings, and tags.

classes.name: _MetaChip
classes.description: A small widget displaying an icon and label, used for recipe metadata.

classes.name: _Section
classes.description: A widget for section headers and content, such as Ingredients and Directions.

classes.name: _BulletedList
classes.description: Displays a list of items with bullets, used for ingredients.

classes.name: _NumberedList
classes.description: Displays a list of items with numbered indicators, used for directions.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the RecipeDetailScreen, including app bar, image, and recipe details sections.
